title: Pocketwire Business Profile Buyer Claims, Seller Responses and Seller Protection
content:
## Opening a claim

A buyer can open one claim per sale within the tier's claim window in calendar days after the sale date. The claim reasons are item not received, not as described and unauthorized buyer. On tiers where the claimed amount is held while a claim is open, the claimed amount is held on the business balance of the Pocketwire Business Profile as a dispute hold while the claim is open; the hold is released when the claim closes.

## The seller's response

The seller responds by providing tracking, providing signature-on-delivery proof, refunding, or accepting the claim. The response counts only within the response window: the response is recorded no later than the tier's seller response window in calendar days after the claim opened date. The window is counted from the claim opened date, the day after opening being day 1, and a response on the last day counts. A claim with no response in time is decided for the buyer.

## How a claim is decided

| Claim reason | Decided for the seller when |
|---|---|
| item not received | seller protection applies: the seller responded in time with tracking showing delivery to the buyer's address — or with signature proof when the sale amount is at or above the tier's signature-proof threshold — and the claim amount is within the tier's seller protection maximum |
| unauthorized buyer | the sale shows delivery confirmed by the carrier |
| not as described | decided by the claims team on the evidence; never covered by seller protection |

Refunding or accepting settles the claim for the buyer without a chargeback or chargeback fee. A claim closes as seller won, buyer won or withdrawn by buyer.

## Chargebacks

A chargeback is the debit of the claim amount from the business balance when a claim is decided for the buyer. On tiers whose chargeback fee is refunded when the decision is later reversed for the seller, the fee is credited back if the decision is reversed; a reversal returns the amount of the chargeback.

**Retired clause.** The clause "A claim decided for the buyer debits the claim amount as a chargeback and books a chargeback fee" is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current chargeback fee basis, under which the chargeback fee entry is booked against the chargeback it belongs to.

## Boundary days (hypothetical response window of 10 days)

A claim opened on the 3rd: a response recorded on the 13th (day 10) counts; one recorded on the 14th does not, and the claim is decided for the buyer.
